findings.description: reconcile_stall_max_delay_s has no default value specified. Other tuning parameters in the same section (reconcile_trade_lookback_sec default 300s, position_reconcile_epsilon default min_amount/1e-6) have explicit defaults. Without a default, behavior when unconfigured is implementation-defined.

evidence.quote: stays true for longer than `reconcile_stall_max_delay_s`, runtime MUST emit structured log `RECONCILE_STALL`
evidence.context: Other reconciliation parameters in lines 26-27 specify defaults; this one does not.

findings.proposed_fix: Add an explicit default value for reconcile_stall_max_delay_s (e.g., default: 120s) consistent with the pattern used for reconcile_trade_lookback_sec and position_reconcile_epsilon.

findings.description: open_permission_requires_reconcile MUST equal open_permission_blocked_latch (line 15) but only AT-430 tests this invariant at startup. No AT verifies the invariant holds during runtime latch transitions: when a trigger sets the latch (AT-1242 does not check open_permission_requires_reconcile) or when reconciliation clears it (AT-011 checks latch and reason_codes but not requires_reconcile).

evidence.quote: open_permission_requires_reconcile (bool; MUST equal open_permission_blocked_latch for v5.2)
evidence.context: AT-430 tests startup only. AT-1242 and AT-011 omit requires_reconcile from pass criteria.

findings.proposed_fix: Add pass criteria to AT-1242 and AT-011 requiring open_permission_requires_reconcile == open_permission_blocked_latch after the transition, or add a dedicated invariant AT covering all latch state transitions.

findings.description: Reconciliation criteria 1 (label matching) and 2 (position matching within epsilon) have no negative ATs proving reconciliation fails when they are not met. AT-1100 covers missing trades and AT-1263 covers REST failure, but no AT tests that the latch remains set when inflight intents do not match exchange orders or when positions diverge beyond position_reconcile_epsilon.

evidence.quote: Ledger inflight intents (non-terminal) match exchange open orders by label (all matched within label disambiguation rules per §1.1.2).
evidence.context: Lines 25-26 define two success criteria with no corresponding negative ATs. Only criteria 3 (AT-1100, AT-1263) has negative coverage.

findings.proposed_fix: Add two ATs: one proving reconciliation fails and latch remains set when inflight intents do not match exchange open orders by label, and one proving reconciliation fails when positions diverge beyond position_reconcile_epsilon.

findings.description: open_permission_reason_codes is an array and criterion 4 requires 'All reconcile-class reason codes cleared' before reconciliation succeeds. No AT tests the multi-code accumulation scenario where multiple triggers fire (e.g., WS_BOOK_GAP + INVENTORY_MISMATCH) and only one is resolved — verifying the latch remains set until all codes are cleared.

evidence.quote: All reconcile-class reason codes cleared (no unresolved WS gaps, inventory mismatches, or session termination flags).
evidence.context: AT-1242 tests individual trigger events. AT-011 tests successful reconciliation but from a single-code precondition.

findings.proposed_fix: Add an AT with precondition of two or more concurrent reason codes where only a subset of triggering conditions are resolved, proving reconciliation fails and latch remains set until all codes are cleared.
